purpose: Keep a worker workspace and checkpoint across disposable ChatGPT hosted machines without CircleCI or Cloudflare.
start_of_run: Read the worker handoff and LATEST.json if it exists.
Fetch every listed capsule part separately through the GitHub connector.
Verify each part length/hash from manifest before concatenation.
Decode and verify archive size/SHA before extraction.
Extract only with path traversal protection.
Verify workspace manifest before continuing work.
If no valid capsule exists, materialize exact source once and then create the first capsule.
end_of_run: After meaningful work, make a checkpoint inside the workspace describing exact source SHA, completed work, tests and next action.
Pack the smallest useful workspace, not caches that can cheaply be regenerated.
Split base64 representation into separate GitHub files small enough to be fetched without truncation; default 2048 characters per part for maximum reliability.
Create all immutable part files and manifest first.
Only after every part is durably readable and its Git blob SHA matches the local bytes, update this worker's LATEST.json to the new capsule.
Never point LATEST.json at a partial capsule.
failure_policy: If restore verification fails, do not reconstruct missing bytes from conversation memory.
Fall back to the previous valid capsule referenced by history/handoff if available.
A capsule failure is not permission to stop useful product work when exact source can still be materialized from GitHub.
